CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32), 
	requested_amount_paise INTEGER, 
	tenure_months INTEGER, 
	llm_calls INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_attempts (
	session_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES conversation_sessions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_latest_documents (
	session_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES conversation_sessions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_turn_traces (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES conversation_sessions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES conversation_sessions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pending_agent_questions (
	session_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	question TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES conversation_sessions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transitions (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	from_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	to_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES conversation_sessions (id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversation_sessions_customer_id ON conversation_sessions (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversation_turn_traces_session_id ON conversation_turn_traces (session_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_messages_session_id ON messages (session_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_transitions_session_id ON transitions (session_id)
